sloka: निर्मितं सर्वकामैस्तु मनोहरमनुत्तमम् ।न तु शीतं न चोष्णं च सर्वर्तुसुखदं शुभम् ।। ७.१५.४२ ॥
transliteration: nirmitaṁ sarvakāmaistu manoharamanuttamam ।na tu śītaṁ na coṣṇaṁ ca sarvartusukhadaṁ śubham ।। 7.15.42 ॥

translations.english: It was an unsurpassed, mind-captivating creation, endowed with all desired comforts, neither cold nor hot, providing pleasantness in all seasons, and truly auspicious.
